snapshotLabel: 13 Nov 2026 · before the scheduled Pink inauguration

sources.title: Operating network · About Namma Metro
sources.summary: BMRCL lists 96.10 km in passenger operation: Purple 43.49 km, Green 33.46 km and Yellow 19.15 km, with the endpoints shown in this atlas.

sources.title: Pink elevated section: inauguration scheduled
sources.summary: The PMO schedules inauguration of Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere on 13 November, with a metro ride around 12:45 PM IST. The announcement does not establish the start of public passenger services.

sources.title: Metro Parking Policy · network background
sources.summary: PDF page 5 records 83 operating stations, the remaining 21.26 km of Phase 2 under construction, Blue 2A (19.75 km) and 2B (38.44 km), and Phase 3 (44.65 km). This is dated context, not a November construction measurement.

sources.title: Question 3087 · ORR–Airport project progress
sources.summary: The combined 58.19 km Phase 2A and 2B project had reached 72.50% physical progress as of 30 June 2026. This figure applies to the whole project, not either individual section or station.

sources.title: Two Phase 3 corridors approved
sources.summary: Approval covers JP Nagar 4th Phase–Kempapura (32.15 km) and Hosahalli–Kadabagere (12.50 km), together 44.65 km and 31 stations. The body lists 22 and 9 stations; the headline has a conflicting first-corridor count.

sources.title: Question 3428 · Phase 3 implementation
sources.summary: Annexure I reports 2.30% physical progress for the combined Phase 3 project as of 28 February 2026. This is a historical project-wide figure, not a current corridor or station percentage.

sources.title: Phase 3A proposal under examination
sources.summary: The ministry describes a Karnataka proposal of about 37 km awaiting examination before central sanction. A newer official sanction was not established in this research; this atlas leaves the corridor proposed and flags the age of this evidence.

lines.name: Purple Line
lines.note: The complete east–west corridor is listed by BMRCL as operational.

lines.name: Green Line
lines.note: BMRCL lists the full north–south corridor, including the Madavara extension, in passenger operation.

lines.name: Yellow Line
lines.note: BMRCL lists RV Road–Delta Electronics Bommasandra as operational. RV Road connects to the Green Line.

lines.name: Pink Line
lines.note: Elevated section: inauguration scheduled for 13 Nov 2026. Public passenger opening is not verified. The underground section remains a construction corridor in the retrieved official evidence.

sections.name: Elevated · Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere
sections.label: Inauguration scheduled 13 Nov 2026
sections.note: No confirmed public-service start in the cited announcement.

sections.name: Underground · Dairy Circle–Nagawara
sections.label: Under construction
sections.note: No current station-level completion percentage or opening date verified.

lines.name: Blue Line
lines.note: The ORR and airport corridors are under construction. The latest directly verified official percentage is a historical combined-project measurement; it is not a live estimate.

sections.name: Phase 2A · Central Silk Board–KR Puram
sections.label: 19.75 km · under construction
sections.note: No separate current official completion percentage verified.

sections.name: Phase 2B · KR Puram–Airport
sections.label: 38.44 km · under construction
sections.note: No separate current official completion percentage verified.

lines.name: Orange Line
lines.note: Cabinet-approved western ORR corridor. Implementation is documented in Parliament. No verified current station-by-station construction percentages are available.

lines.name: Magadi Road corridor
lines.note: Cabinet-approved Magadi Road corridor. Its administrative and construction status is Phase 3 implementation; it is not a passenger-service line.

lines.name: Red corridor
lines.note: The retrieved ministry release records a proposal awaiting appraisal before central sanction. A later official approval was not verified. Names and mapped route are indicative; no passenger service or construction completion is implied.
lines.geometryNote: Proposed OpenStreetMap corridor; indicative and subject to revision.
